fusions.name: Snaring Sweep
fusions.desc: Deals 12 damage to every enemy within 4 tiles, each with a 50% chance to be left [Slowed] for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to enemies within 4 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Cast Line
fusions.desc: Fires a bolt that deals 8 damage and leaps to 2 more enemies within 3.5 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up.

fusions.name: Drawstring
fusions.desc: Strings a 6-tile line for 6 seconds that drags nearby enemies inward.

fusions.name: Catch and Keep
fusions.desc: Each time you afflict an enemy, you regain 5 mana. Once every 6 seconds.
